label: estimation cost: estimated vs true-state feedback; thresholds are project-defined
pairing: same seed => same filter-init, gyro and star-tracker random draws in both modes; realized measurements differ once trajectories diverge
windows: primary: starts at the later of the paired runs' 2% settling times (config fallback if either never settles); *_late: fixed late window

E0.description: nominal start at the target attitude, 0.01 rad/s initial rate

E5.description: E6 acquisition, then a 30-sample (30 s) tracker outage from t = 450 s, inside both steady-state windows

E6.description: 60 deg / 0.1 rad/s acquisition, extended to 600 s

E6_200s.description: the 200 s benchmark run length used by evaluate_e6_benchmark.py
